card.name: Combination and co-administration wording
card.fires_on: Small words and word pieces inside drug-interaction passages, where text refers to use in combination, alone versus with another drug, or concomitant use. It also fires on section cross-reference markers.

modes.label: Drug lists in combination
modes.description: Commas or linking words between drugs given together as a regimen or compared with use alone.
modes.example: Peripheral and optic neuropathy were reported with the use of the combination regimen of Pretomanid Tablets<<,>> bedaquiline, and linezolid

modes.label: Cross-reference links
modes.description: The word 'and' inside see Warnings and Precautions references in interaction text.
modes.example: may increase the risk of serious hepatotoxicity [see Warnings<< and>> Precautions (5.4)]

modes.label: Inside interaction terms
modes.description: Partway through drug or section words about interactions.

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning accompanying or surrounding, such as companion, accompany and surrounding.
card.plain: It marks spots in interaction text where one drug is being discussed alongside another.
